title: Bolero predicts cell-state-specific gene regulation from DNA across species
summary: Bolero predicted cell-specific responses to AP-1 activity and transferred a human-trained response model to mouse and macaque neuronal enhancers, according to Arc Institute. Its announcement also describes a computational AP-1/cofactor spacing hypothesis; these virtual edits do not establish biological causality. This summary is limited to the October 20, 2026 institutional announcement, which identifies a collaboration with Harvard Medical School and describes a 10.8-million-cell atlas. The linked paper is a preprint; full-paper methods and experimental independence were not assessed.

evidence.tested: Human-trained AP-1 response predictions compared with mouse/macaque neuronal enhancers; virtual regulatory perturbations.
evidence.unknown: Source checking does not establish independent confirmation. Review date: 2026-11-15.
evidence.ai_role: Bolero, a Transformer conditioned on cell-state embeddings, predicts cell-state-specific gene regulation directly from DNA and estimates responses in unprofiled cell states.
